Maya (Support): Customer (AcmeCorp) reporting intermittent 599s on streaming /v1/generate when sending ~120k char prompts. They see connection terminated with '599 chunked read timeout' and SDK retries doubling requests. Paste log and repro curl.

Customer log: "error: stream terminated: 599 read_timeout after 12s"

Maya (Support): Repro curl they ran: ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -d '{"model":"open-redwood/large", "input":"<big prompt>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```

Maya (Support): They've captured an SDK trace showing client retry after 10s, then a second request that succeeds but double-billed. Customer asks for workaround while we investigate.

Devon (SRE): Can you drop the raw request body + size? Curious about content-length and chunking. Also enable edge debug: X-Request-Debug: 1 and send trace id. I'll correlate with ingress logs. Suspect h2 window stalls + kvcache eviction under large prefix.

Ricardo (Runtime Eng): We saw a similar pattern with long prefixes where KV cache grows and the runtime occasionally stalls flushing. If we hit a stall the proxy sometimes returns 599. Repro idea: run the same prompt with --stream=false and with smaller prefix to compare.

Sophie (DevEx): I'll draft a minimal repro using the JS SDK. Maya, can you ask customer to run this snippet and paste the request id? It'll help us fetch traces quickly.

orchard-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created, priority P2, assigned to eng-runtime.

Devon (SRE): Preliminary grep shows an upstream spike at 2026-02-12T18:14:22Z with tcp retransmits. Can eng-runtime add a temporary config to reduce kvcache retention for the tenant? That may avoid the eviction pause.

Ricardo (Runtime Eng): We can push a tenant-scoped kv_max_entries down to 50 as a canary. Sophie, will SDK retries still trigger duplicate billing? We should confirm idempotency header behavior.

Sophie (DevEx): SDK v1.12 includes idempotency via X-Request-Id by default for generate. If customer is on v1.10 they might not have it. I'll send a short patch curl and an SDK upgrade snippet.

Maya (Support): Sending customer: upgrade SDK to v1.12, set X-Request-Id, retry disabled, use --stream=false as a stopgap. I'll update them and request the debug headers and request id.

Devon (SRE): After config change we should watch p95 and 5xx for that tenant for the next 2 hours. I'll add a temporary dashboard and @ricardo please watch logs for 'kvcache stall' traces.

Ricardo (Runtime Eng): Will do. Thanks. Keep customer updated: we'll revert the canary if no improvement.

Maya (Support): ACME confirmed they can reproduce. They ran SDK v1.12 with X-Request-Id and saw no double billing after 3 attempts. They're waiting on our canary. :pray: 

Sophie (DevEx): Sending the JS snippet now in thread.

Maya (Support): I'll close loop with customer once SRE confirms stability.
